relays.description: List of relay server addresses to use for data transfer. Specifying multiple allows failover or load balancing.

rendezvous_server.description: The WebSocket URL of the rendezvous server used for handshake. Both peers must use the same value.

force_direct.description: Disable relay server support and force a direct connection between peers.

force_relay.description: Always route traffic over a relay server to hide IP addresses from peers.

verbose.description: Enable verbose logging to stdout for debugging purposes.
